params.prompt: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page: the top half is a photoreal close-up of a black work truck door with the attached chrome emblem as the door badge and "425-283-6496" lettered in steel grey, a welding rig in the bed behind; the bottom half is a dark steel form panel with the heading "Tell me about the job", four fields (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?), a teal-blue button "Send the request", and "Text · Call · Instagram" tags. Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no pastels.
